name: BONE KNIGHT

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
BONE KNIGHT DIFFICULTY 5
Size 2 frightening undead
Perception 10 (+0); darksight
Defense 14 (large shield); Health 20; Insanity —; Corruption 1
Strength 13 (+3), Agility 12 (+2), Intellect 8 (–2), Will 13 (+3)
Speed 14
Immune damage from cold, disease, poison; asleep,
diseased, fatigued, frightened, poisoned
ATTACK OPTIONS
Lance (melee) +3 with 1 boon (1d6 + 1)
Hooves (melee) +3 with 1 boon (1d6)
SPECIAL ATTACKS
Stab and Kick The bone knight attacks with its lance and
its hooves.
Trample The bone knight moves up to its Speed in a
straight line. If the bone knight enters the space of
another creature, that creature must get a success on an
Agility challenge roll or take 1d6 damage and fall prone.
SPECIAL ACTIONS
Gallop The bone knight moves up to three times its Speed.

name: HARBINGER

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
HARBINGER DIFFICULTY 50
Size 1 frightening undead
Perception 16 (+6); darksight
Defense 13; Health 60; Insanity —; Corruption 6
Strength 10 (+0), Agility 13 (+3), Intellect 14 (+4), Will 13 (+3)
Speed 14; flier
Immune damage from cold, disease, poison; asleep,
diseased, fatigued, poisoned
Clinging Shadows Magical shadows swirl around and
partially obscure the harbinger. The shadows suppress
natural light and light created by spells of rank 4 or less.
Command the Dead Each undead friendly to the harbinger
that is within medium range of it makes attack rolls and
challenge rolls with 1 boon and imposes 1 bane on attack
rolls made against it.
ATTACK OPTIONS
Sword (melee) +0 with 3 boons (2d6 + 2)
SPECIAL ATTACKS
Blackest Fire The harbinger hurls ribbons of black fire at
a target creature or object within extreme range. Make
an Intellect attack roll against the target’s Agility. On a
success, the black fire hits and deals 3d6 damage. On an
attack roll of 20 or higher that beats the target number
by at least 5, the target takes 3d6 extra damage.
MAGIC
Power 3
Necromancy spectral grasp (4), harvest soul (2), shrieking
skull (1), well of dark power (1)
Shadow wall of darkness (4), darkness (2), shadow dart (2),
shadow stride (1), black bolts of the Underworld (1)
